# GritSync — NCLEX Application Processing Agency

## About GritSync
GritSync is a professional NCLEX application processing agency that helps Filipino nurses and internationally educated nurses (IENs) obtain their US nursing licensure. We handle end-to-end document processing, NYSED submissions, BON (Board of Nursing) applications, Pearson VUE registration, and ATT (Authorization to Test) acquisition — so nurses can focus on studying, not paperwork.

## What We Do
- Complete NCLEX application processing from document collection through exam scheduling
- NYSED (New York State Education Department) document submission and review management
- BON (Board of Nursing) application filing across multiple US states
- Pearson VUE registration and ATT facilitation
- Real-time application status tracking via a personalized dashboard
- Professional @gritsync.com business email for every client account
- Secure document storage, review, and digital delivery
- NCLEX sponsorship program for qualified nurses
- 24/7 client support throughout the entire process

## Who We Serve
GritSync primarily serves Filipino nurses and other internationally educated nurses seeking to become Registered Nurses (RN) in the United States. We guide nurses from the Philippines who want to work in US hospitals, healthcare facilities, and nursing homes.

## Key Facts
- Processing Agency: Yes — we handle all paperwork on your behalf
- Target Clients: Filipino nurses, internationally educated nurses, Philippine nursing board passers
- Exam Supported: NCLEX-RN (National Council Licensure Examination for Registered Nurses)
- Processing Time: Varies by state; typically 3–9 months total
- Business Email Included: Free @gritsync.com email with every account
- Support: 24/7 client support
- Tracking: Real-time status dashboard for every step of the process
- Website: https://gritsync.com

## NCLEX Process Overview (13 Steps)
1. Documents Collection — Client gathers and submits required documents
2. Documents Review — GritSync verifies completeness and accuracy
3. NYSED Document Review — GritSync submits documents to NYSED for evaluation
4. BON Application — Board of Nursing application filed on client's behalf
5. BON Processing — State board processes the application
6. Pearson VUE Registration — Client registered for the NCLEX exam
7. Mandatory Courses — Required pre-exam courses completed
8. ATT Issued — Authorization to Test received from NBON
9. Exam Scheduled — Client books exam slot at Pearson VUE testing center
10. Exam Taken — NCLEX examination completed
11. Results Pending — Quick Results available via Pearson VUE (48-hour results)
12. Results Received — Pass/Fail notification received
13. License Issued — Official RN license issued by the state Board of Nursing

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is the NCLEX?
The NCLEX-RN (National Council Licensure Examination for Registered Nurses) is the standardized exam required for all nursing graduates to obtain a nursing license in the United States and Canada. It is administered by Pearson VUE on behalf of the NCSBN (National Council of State Boards of Nursing).

### Who needs NCLEX processing assistance?
Filipino nurses and other internationally educated nurses who graduated from nursing schools outside the United States need to go through a credential evaluation and application process before they can take the NCLEX. This involves submitting transcripts, nursing board certificates, and other documents to US state boards, which is where GritSync provides expert assistance.

### How long does NCLEX processing take?
The full process typically takes 3–9 months depending on the state, document completeness, and NYSED review timelines. GritSync's real-time tracking keeps clients informed at every step.

### What documents are required?
Typical required documents include: nursing school diploma and transcript, Philippine nursing board certificate (PRC), Certificate of Good Standing, passport, and other state-specific requirements. GritSync provides a complete document checklist for every client.

### What states does GritSync process applications for?
GritSync processes applications for multiple US states. Contact us or request a quote for specific state availability.

### Is there a sponsorship program?
Yes. GritSync offers an NCLEX sponsorship program for qualified nurses. Sponsored nurses receive financial assistance covering processing fees in exchange for a service commitment. Visit https://gritsync.com/sponsorship for details.
